blocks.text: WHEN Timothy John Jala opened the list of topnotchers for the November 2026 Chemical Engineer Licensure Examination (CHELE), he had already convinced himself that he had no place among the country’s best-performing examinees. The 23-year-old University of San Carlos (USC) graduate had spent the hours before the release worrying about questions he might have answered incorrectly. He had even expected to find his name missing from the list. Instead, the Boholano found himself at the very top.
